composition_qualification: Table 1 reports analyzed ICP-OES oxide composition in mol%, not nominal batch recipes. Source labels qualify these glass formulations; no normalization, analytical correction, certified purity, exact final stoichiometry or molecular-species identity is inferred. Reported zero Al2O3 is a table entry, not proof of absolute absence at every detection limit.
density_scope: Catalog-only source-reported measured density of the as-prepared, annealed and reannealed glass. No pressure-compressed variant is included. Calculated molar volumes and atomic packing densities and all other properties are excluded. Exact density-test temperature, pressure, humidity, porosity and independent specimen count are unknown. Room temperature is preserved without numeric conversion. The hardness humidity and viscosity standard do not qualify this density measurement. Archimedes measurement does not establish true/bulk/apparent density classification or zero porosity.

statistics.bound_note: The source reports a source-wide maximum standard-deviation bound of <=0.002 g/cm3 (written as +/-0.002 g/cm3); Table 1 gives no individual row standard deviations. The bound is not assigned as six measured SDs, a confidence interval, standard error or zero uncertainty.
statistics.repetition_note: At least 10 repetitions per sample are reported. This is a measurement-repeat lower bound; the independent specimen count and preparation-batch count are not stated.

exclusions: All pressure-compressed states, including 1 GPa and 2 GPa treatments.
Calculated molar volumes and atomic packing densities, and all properties other than six Table 1 measured densities.
Exact temperature, pressure, humidity, porosity, independent specimen count, individual SDs and row-specific melt schedules are not supplied.
No numerical Tg property is admitted or used to infer an exact row-specific thermal schedule.
No extra identity for repeated measurements, thermal states, bare-code overlap or computed values.
separate_source_transcription_review: A separate read-only source review corroborated the selected text and article-specific license link. The authoring task independently checked the exact PDF bytes and page renders; no independent scientific review is claimed.
